note: Corrections to the lists of the lessons of curriculum/japanese/parallel/zh-lessons.yaml (never edited here), applied in memory by applyCorrections in scripts/generate-pack-ja.mjs. moves: { word | grammar, from, to, why } takes a word row (with its fields) from one lesson's words or a pattern from one lesson's grammar_intro to another lesson's; removals: { word | grammar, lesson, why } takes it out of the lesson's list for good; additions: { lesson, word: <a words row with entry, form, gloss> | grammar: <pattern id>, why } adds one (a word row is marked extra). A lesson's grammar_taught is derived from grammar_intro and its phrases. Each operation throws, naming the lesson, when what it refers to is not there.

moves.why: これ: the sentences of lesson 13 do not use it; the first sentence with it is in lesson 34
授業を受ける: first used in lesson 66 (568); lesson 15 says "before class", not "attend"
いつ: first used in lesson 31 (213)
ひと: lesson 32 counts people with the counter 人; the first sentence with the word ひと is in lesson 41 (341)
いくつか: first used in lesson 48 (401)

removals.why: too vague to name: "a sentence that shows a change" is not one pattern; 雨が降ってきました is the pattern <verb> + てきました (ja-n3-g045), which lesson 47 already has
repeats は/を and ます/ました: NをVます／NをVました is the object particle を (ja-n5-g006) with the polite verb (ja-n5-g023, ja-n5-g025), which are taught already

additions.why: the word of 普通形と思う (phrase 480 says 思います); a new word, a new label
